mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: At Cyicaro, we believe in the power of integrated farming to create sustainable livelihoods and regenerate our lands. By combining agriculture, livestock, compost production, and forage management, we create a holistic ecosystem that benefits both people and the planet. Our commitment is to produce nutritious food, regenerate the soil, and share our knowledge with the community.

why.title: Why Support Us?
why.desc: Your contribution is an investment in a sustainable and resilient future. We are building a circular economic model that requires initial funding to develop our infrastructure, from production tools to waste processing. Your support is crucial to realize this vision.

social.title: Social Impact
social.desc: Contribute to local roots, education, and sustainable job creation. Your support helps build a resilient community from the ground up.

economic.title: Economic Viability
economic.desc: Invest in a circular model that creates value at every stage, from production to waste transformation, ensuring long-term financial sustainability.

environmental.title: Environmental Impact
environmental.desc: Fund a project that actively regenerates soils, preserves biodiversity, and promotes a resilient production method against climate change.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: To be a leading example of sustainable integrated agriculture in Rwanda and beyond, inspiring communities to adopt regenerative practices that restore the land while ensuring food security and economic opportunities. We envision a future where farming works in harmony with nature.

commitment.title: Our Sustainable Commitment
commitment.desc: Our circular model is our commitment in action. Crops feed our livestock, whose waste is transformed into rich compost. This compost regenerates our soil, allowing us to grow more nutritious crops. This closed-loop system minimizes waste, maximizes resource efficiency, and creates a truly sustainable farming ecosystem.

about.title: About Us | Cyicaro Farm
about.meta: Learn about Cyicaro Farm, a sustainable agroforestry project founded in 2019 in Mushishiro, Rwanda.

hero.title: About Cyicaro Project Farm
hero.subtitle: Driving sustainable rural development through an integrated circular economy in Mushishiro.

problem.title: The Problem We Solve
problem.desc: Rural areas face significant challenges: underutilized land, youth unemployment, low crop valorization, and a lack of agro-processing. Cyicaro acts to transform these challenges into opportunities.

p1.title: Land Valorization
p1.desc: Rehabilitating unused parcels with advanced soil conservation practices.

p2.title: Job Creation
p2.desc: Creating local employment and providing practical on-field training.

p3.title: Local Valorization
p3.desc: Improving quality, sorting, targeting proximity markets, and small-scale transformation.

p4.title: Food Security
p4.desc: Supporting school canteens and vulnerable households directly from our harvests.

circular.title: Our Circular Approach
circular.subtitle: Crops ↔ Livestock ↔ Compost ↔ Transformation
circular.desc: This interconnected cycle transforms underutilized resources into sustainable economic and social value for the Mushishiro community. Everything is reused; nothing is wasted.

economic.title: Economic Viability

whyNow.desc: We have proven our model works. Scaling now means more products, fewer losses, and direct, amplified social impact for the schools and households of Mushishiro. The foundation is laid; it's time to build the future.

integration_power.title: The Power of Integration
integration_power.description:
These activities are not separate initiatives; they are deeply integrated.

Farming provides food for our livestock and resources for our processing center.
Livestock provides manure to enrich our soils.
Our forests protect our land.

This holistic system creates a resilient, self-sustaining farm that benefits the environment and our community.

activitiesPage.title: Our Activities
activitiesPage.subtitle: Discover our integrated farming initiatives building a sustainable future.

items.title: Macadamia Cultivation
items.short: Sustainable macadamia nut farming contributing to long-term community value.
items.full: We grow hundreds of macadamia trees as a long-term investment. This high-value crop provides excellent nutrition, improves soil health through agroforestry practices, and creates sustainable economic opportunities for local farmers.

items.title: Livestock & Water Sources
items.short: Integrated livestock management relying on clean, protected water sources.
items.full: Our livestock management is deeply integrated with our water conservation efforts. We ensure clean drinking water for our animals while protecting local springs.

items.title: Citrus & Fruits
items.short: Diverse fruit orchards providing fresh, nutritious food locally.
items.full: Our vibrant orchards are filled with various citrus trees and other fruits. These orchards improve local food security, provide vital habitats for pollinators, and serve as a reliable source of fresh produce.

items.title: Banana Plantations
items.short: Staple green bananas ensuring continuous food security.
items.full: Bananas are a critical staple crop in our region. Our sustainable banana plantations provide year-round food security and income. The large leaves also provide essential shade.

items.title: Animal Husbandry
items.short: Healthy animals providing essential resources and natural fertilizer.
items.full: We raise a variety of livestock with a focus on animal welfare. Our animals provide essential protein sources, and their manure is a key ingredient in our high-quality compost.

items.title: Composting
items.short: Transforming organic waste into nutrient-rich soil.
items.full: Composting is the heart of our regenerative cycle. We gather agricultural waste and animal manure, transforming them into rich organic compost to naturally enrich the soil.

items.title: Forage & Pastures
items.short: Nutritious grasses grown to feed our animals sustainably.
items.full: We dedicate specific areas to growing high-quality forage crops for our livestock. This ensures our animals receive optimal nutrition year-round and allows rotational grazing.

items.title: Forestry & Agroforestry
items.short: Integrating trees into agriculture to protect and restore the land.
items.full: Our forestry initiatives combat erosion, improve water retention, and enhance local biodiversity. By integrating native trees, we create natural windbreaks and provide sustainable timber.

items.title: Social Impact
items.short: Empowering communities through jobs and education.
items.full: Our farm is a catalyst for community development. We create fair-wage jobs, offer training in regenerative agriculture, and support local educational initiatives.

items.title: Innovative Crops
items.short: Experimenting with new, resilient plant varieties.
items.full: We continually test and integrate new, climate-resilient crop varieties. This helps us adapt to changing weather patterns and discover new high-value markets.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do - Cyicaro Farm
whatWeDo.meta: Explore the integrated activities of Cyicaro Farm: Agriculture, Livestock, Composting, and more. See how we build a sustainable future.

hero.title: Our Activities
hero.desc: An integrated model for a resilient and prosperous future.

agriculture.title: Agriculture
agriculture.desc: Our diverse farming practices form the foundation of our regenerative system, emphasizing high-value crops, food security, and soil health.

macadamia.title: Macadamia
macadamia.desc: We grow hundreds of macadamia trees on our Cyicaro site. These trees represent a long-term investment in nutritious, high-value products and contribute to our agroforestry system.

sugar.title: Sugar Cane
sugar.desc: Our sugar cane plants are a source of local, sustainable sweetness. This crop is well-suited to our climate and provides raw materials for value-added products.

citrus.title: Citrus & Fruits
citrus.desc: Our diverse orchard thrives with a variety of citrus and other fruits, offering fresh, healthy options to the local community.

banana.title: Bananas
banana.desc: We bolster local food security with extensive green banana plantations. These are a staple food source and key component of community well-being.

livestock.title: Livestock
livestock.desc: Our animals are essential to our circular model, providing manure for compost, aiding in land management, and supplying valuable products.

cattle.title: Cattle
cattle.desc: Our herd contributes to soil fertility through managed grazing and provides manure, a crucial component of our organic compost production.

poultry.title: Poultry / Laying Hens
poultry.desc: Our flock of laying hens provides fresh, nutritious eggs to the community and contributes to pest control and soil enrichment.

bees.title: Bees
bees.desc: Our apiaries are vital for pollinating our diverse crops and orchards. They also produce delicious raw honey.

goats.title: Goats
goats.desc: Hardy and efficient, our goats help manage vegetation and provide milk and manure.

pigs.title: Pigs
pigs.desc: Our pigs play a role in converting farm by-products into valuable protein and contribute to our composting system.

compost.title: Compost & Manure
compost.desc: At the heart of our regenerative process is our high-quality compost. By transforming animal manure and organic waste into nutrient-rich soil amendment, we close the loop.

forage.title: Forage
forage.desc: We dedicate land to growing nutritious forage for our livestock. This ensures our animals are healthy and well-fed sustainably.

forest.title: Forestry
forest.desc: Our agroforestry initiatives integrate trees into our agricultural landscape to enhance biodiversity, prevent soil erosion, and improve water retention.

impact.title: Empowering Our Local Community
impact.desc: Our farm is more than just an agricultural project; it's a hub for community growth. By providing fair-wage employment, educational programs for local youth, and supporting local schools, we ensure our success translates into regional prosperity.

integration.title: The Power of Integration
integration.desc: These activities are not separate initiatives; they are deeply integrated. Farming provides food for our livestock and resources for our processing center. Livestock provides manure to enrich our soils. Our forests protect our land. This holistic system creates a resilient, self-sustaining farm.
